What’s new with Xumo?

The Evolution of FAST Into Mainstream TV

FAST has evolved far beyond a destination for reruns, emerging as a mainstream television experience defined by exclusives, original programming, live sports, and recognizable entertainment brands. Learn why audiences and advertisers are increasingly embracing FAST.

Nov 10, 2026

Why TV should be part of every creator’s growth strategy

Creators have mastered building audiences on social. On an Advertising Week New York panel, industry leaders explored why TV is their next big opportunity, and what it takes to succeed there.

Oct 19, 2026

Distribution Is Becoming Marketing: What Industry Leaders Are Seeing Across Streaming, Advertising, and Audience Engagement

At the inaugural Xumo Executive Retreat, leaders from across content, advertising, technology, and distribution discussed the forces reshaping audience behavior and the future of media. Three themes surfaced repeatedly: distribution is becoming a growth engine; consumers no longer distinguish between platforms; and fandom, trust, and authenticity are emerging as strategic advantages.
